meta.title: No-slip continuum CFD observable error
meta.physical_scope: Conditional endpoint velocity-sensor and integrated-pressure error bounds for a constant-density, forced, incompressible Newtonian model with selected stationary no-slip walls, after explicit SI nondimensionalization and with an adopted distributional weak extension of the physical balance at the stated Sobolev regularity. The extension matches the continuous MINI equation. The claim is limited to the smooth strong-solution MINI branch and has no empirical validation, weak-limit pressure-rate, or Reynolds-uniform assertion.

meta.title: Conditional nonlinear Couette energy stability — conditional physical prediction
meta.physical_scope: Conditional energy estimate for an already-existing smooth incompressible constant-density Newtonian solution in a horizontally periodic channel with Couette wall velocities and zero perturbation trace. The sufficient decay threshold applies only on the stated solution interval; no global existence, optimal transition Reynolds number, or empirical applicability is asserted.
